title: Power torsion in raw cohomology restriction kernels
statement: Let $f:X\to T$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions], $F$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent], $I$ an injective resolution of $F$, $q\in\mathbb N$, $W$ an affine open of $T$, and $a\in\Gamma(T,W)$. Let $P=\operatorname{sectionCohomologyPresheaf}(f_*I,q)$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices], and let $r$ denote restriction from $W$ to $D(a)$; write $a_D$ for restriction of the scalar $a$ to $D(a)$. For every $x\in P(W)$ with $r(x)=0$ there exists $n\in\mathbb N$ with $a^n\cdot x=0$.

source.place: Tag 09MR (lemma-invert-s-cohomology), tensor-unit specialization, injectivity and zero-fraction criterion; Tag 01E4, resolution/evaluation comparison.

proof.text: Put Y=f⁻¹W and b=f^♯a. Y is qcqs and the restriction G of F is quasi-coherent. Restriction preserves injective resolutions. Evaluation of f_*I at W and D(a) is sections of I on f⁻¹W and f⁻¹D(a)=D(b), respectively. Exact evaluation commutes with homology, identifying P restriction and scalar actions with the corresponding cohomology restriction and pulled-back scalar actions.

Apply invertS_cohomology on Y with L=O_Y and section b. Under the canonical tensor-unit identification, x gives a degree-zero numerator ξ. The numerator equation at n=0 identifies the image of [0,ξ] with res(x)=0. Injectivity of the additive equivalence implies [0,ξ]=0.

Apply cohomologyFraction_eventually_zero to the zero fraction [0,ξ]. The resulting transition kills ξ. Under the tensor-unit identifications this transition is multiplication by b^n: tensorPowSection of b evaluates to b^n and tensoring with G acts by that scalar. Transport through the resolution comparisons to get a^n x=0. If a=0 choose n=1; for a a unit the restriction is an isomorphism and x=0. Empty opens and degree zero are included.

proof_origin.place: Tensor-unit specialization of the canonical comparison; resolution computation from Tag 01E4.

lean.statement: theorem sectionCohomologyPresheaf_kernel_pow_annihilates {X T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ T) (F : X.Modules) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] [F.IsQuasicoherent] (I : InjectiveResolution F) (q : ℕ) (W : T.Opens) (hW : IsAffineOpen W) (a : Γ(T, W)) : let K := ((pushforward f).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex let P := sectionCohomologyPresheaf K q ∀ x : P.obj (op W), (P.map (homOfLE (T.basicOpen_le a)).op).hom x = 0 → ∃ n : ℕ, a ^ n • x = 0
